name: Buildings above an overgrown wall, Macau
summary: At the steps to the entrance through a massive stone wall, overhung by trailing blooms, two boatwomen face a man who (it seems) has put down his pole and baskets of produce at the foot of the wall. Below the tree (upper right) the façade of the church of S. José can just be seen.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
